page: Vultr voc-s-16c-128gb-2560s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical AMD EPYC cores running at 2.0 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64 and includes hyper-threading. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled and consists of a 2560 GB NVMe SSD. No GPU hardware is included in this configuration.

Benchmark results indicate strong memory performance, with write large block memory bandwidth placing in the top tier (top 10%) and read-only large block memory bandwidth in the top 25%. Passmark memory scores and stress-ng single-core CPU performance also rank in the top 25%. Multi-core processing, static web serving throughput, and database operations perform within the average range. Cryptographic operations are supported by hardware-accelerated AES and SHA_NI instruction sets.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU and substantial local NVMe SSD capacity, this server type offers a resource-dense profile for workloads requiring significant memory and fast local storage without the overhead of a GPU. It is suited for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, text processing, and general-purpose enterprise workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and high memory write bandwidth.
